description: This file is a seed script for populating a database with sample data, including users, articles, and comments, using Prisma ORM and Faker-like data generators.

classes.name: PrismaClient
classes.description: Prisma database client used to connect and interact with the database.

classes.name: RegisteredUser
classes.description: Model representing a registered user, imported from local models.

methods.name: generateUser
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new user with randomized data.

methods.name: generateArticle
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new article with randomized content, associated with a user ID.

methods.name: generateComment
methods.description: Asynchronously adds a comment to an article, associated with a user ID and article slug.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that generates multiple users, their articles, and comments, then disconnects from the database.

ctags.name: articles
ctags.pattern: /^    const articles = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 2 }, () => generateArticle(user.id))/

ctags.name: generateComment
ctags.pattern: /^export const generateComment = async (id: number, slug: string) =>$/

ctags.name: users
ctags.pattern: /^  const users = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 3 }, () => generateUser()));$/
